tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grang sbyor ril nag gi phan yon mos ldan dga' ba'i dbyar rnga bzhugs so//

tshogs gnyis rin chen mchog gi khang bzang nas/ bslab gsum yongs rdzogs seng chen 'gying khri'i steng*// mkhyen ldan lha dbang mnyam nyid rdo rje can// bai ḍūrya mtshungs khyod zhabs spyi bos mchod// gang zhig mkhas dang grub pa'i dpal mnga' zhing*// blo gros chen pos log bshad tshar bcad nas/ */ston pa gnyis pa 'jigs med zla bral ba// rta dbyangs shākya'i mchog kyang phyag bya'i 'os// 'og min zhing du mngon sangs rgyas mod kyang*// gdul bya'i dbang gis zhing 'dir sprul pa'i sku// mi yi gzugs 'chang yon tan mgon po dang*// dharma swa mi brgyud bcas rgyal gyur cig /brtan g.yo zhu dang mi zhu'i khams rnams phan yon che mod 'on kyang 'byor ldan spyad bya'i 'os// rdo dang shing las byung ba'i sman rnams nus pa ldan mod 'on te sbyor ba'ang shes pa med// rwa sgro spu las byung ba'i sman rnams mthu stobs che mod rnam dbye phyed pa shin tu nyung*// rin chen grang sbyor yon tan brjod tshe rma byas dbyar rnga thos dang mtshungs mod 'dir brjod bya// shes rab kyis dben skye bo'i tshogs rnams gzhan du dengs shig de min blo ldan tshogs rnams kyis// yid gnyis 'ching ba rgyab tu bskyur la dad dang gus dang des pa mchog gis 'di nyon cig /nad rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ma rig pa// des spel dug lnga rnam sel ye shes lnga// sman gyi rgyal po yin phyir legs spyad do| |rlung mkhris bad kan ldan 'dus tsha grang las// gyur pa zug rngu'i nad rigs thams cad la// thogs med 'gro ba ril nag ma lags sam| |nad med na yang rgyun du bsten gyur na// rdo rje'i sku 'grub sde brgyad bsrung ba'i mchog /thog ser mtshon gyi 'jigs med bsod nams 'grub| |sgos su sbyor ngan gnyen po sna re yis// 'joms shing thams cad bsdoms pa mchog tu bsngags// de nas so sor dbye ste bstan pa ni| |dbyig dug gnyen por dngul chu gser dngul dang*// zangs lcags lhang tsher rnams ni mchog tu bshad// nyi zla'i 'od la bdugs pa'i dug rigs rnams// bco lnga'i zla 'od bdugs pa'i lcags rtsis srung*// rin chen nyi zer du rlung rlangs dug rnams// pha lam la sogs rin chen rnams kyis srung*// rdo dug rnams la sbal rgyab la sogs bsngags// don snod gar bab gnyen po bzang po drug

/sngo sbyor dug med gsum dang dpa' bo gsum// gang chung sug smel la sogs gnyen po'i mchog /'bru drug yungs kar pad khang nyung son te// sha dug gnyen por gzi mdangs med pa dang*// byi'u la phug nyid ni mchog yin no// shing dug reg dug tsandan a gar sogs// rwa dug gnyen por spyi bor chig skyes yin// mkha' lding dug la rma bya'i sgro gzhob dang*// gzugs mo byi thur dag ni mchog yin no// spu dug stag gi sma ra bubs gcig ste// klad dug klad srin sogs la bu mo yi// spyi skra mchan 'og spu yis skyob par nus// mchin dug bu mo stag lo'i mchin pas 'joms// sbal pa bya rog la sogs sha sbyor gyi// dug rigs gri sha sogs kyis 'joms par byed// skad cig hur thums bse zho'i sbyar dug ni// cha tshan gsum gyis rtsad nas 'byin par byed// dbyig gi dug rnams mu zi ser pos 'joms// se 'bru'i khu bas me drod gso bar byed// de ltar rags rim mdor bsdus bstan pa ste// phan yon zhib rgyas bgrang gis mi lang mod// rang rang sman gyis nad rnams 'joms pa'i phyir// yongs su bsdoms pa'i sbyor ba grang sbyor gyi// ril nag 'di bas che ba gang yang med// 'di ni rgya mtsho'i gting ltar dpag dka' zhing*// phan yon nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi 'joms// sbyor ba gzhan rnams lu ma'i chu lta bur// rang tshad don la phab yod kun gzhom min// 'ga' zhig sbyor ba 'di la rgyab kyis phyogs// blun pos ba lang rmig rjes mtshor mthong bzhin// blo chung byis pa'i sman sbyor ma yin zhing*// zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs bka' rgya can// 'di lta'i ril nag chen mo'i phan yon 'di// shākya'i dge slong dharma kīrti yis// mdo khams sa yi thig le spu thog gi| |mtsho 'gram utpal ser tshal ljongs su sbyar// dge 'dis 'gro kun thams cad mkhyen thob shog
/zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje'i gdams pa las byung ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
